GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 3l off held up, clear 200m, hit line well final 100m # held up/excuses

Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced 4th Two Wide (4L from lead). Stayed same until improving slowly Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & hit top @ 100m. Ran on well late to grab leaders on line. # Speed duel suited

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 7 Lengths turning, cut corner and saved ground rounding turn, couldn't come on in Straight in the only-fair going # never left fence

Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, pocketed rounding turn, steered a path into the cutaway after Straightening Up , moved through and hit Lead 200m, kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 8 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide at the 950m, made no ground to 8 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide with some cover rounding turn and Four Wide Straightening Up , widest down the straight, ran on hitting Lead 30m from post # ran on well/solid
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped another runner. Shifted in under pressure between the 300m and 200m and over the final 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Recovered & raced 4th Two Wide (3L from lead) early . Held Ground until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 500m & improving 3 Wide @ 400m. Pushed along Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & faded in last 150m. # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr stated that he was required to encourage his mount along in the middle stages to hold a handy position. Rdr stated that his mount failed to sprint strongly over the final 400m and just ground its way to the line. Rdr stated that whilst his mount has raced successfully on heavy tracks in the past it did not feel comfortable in the going today. Trainer agreed & added that the gelding raced like a tired horse. Tnr advised the gelding would be spelled immediately. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Blundered on jumping, kicked up from the inside barrier and Settled Down 1.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 3 Lengths turning, railed up rounding turn, looking for a rails run Straightening Up which didn't eventuate, shifted Two Wide and got clear running just inside the 250m, kept trying to post # Had some excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rounding the home turn became held up on heels and was unable to improve until shifting out near the 250m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear, held together turn, Straightened Up half clear and kept on strong to the line increasing margin # led/kicked/too good
(ex Michael, John & Wayne Hawkes) Jumped Ok bumped 2 Lengths 1-1, then 3l Mid Field home turn Good Run Through stays Inside worked home late # running on late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted out and made contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down Outside Lead Beaten off turning by winner who led Kept Going Ok but No Match sound effort # sat 2nd/1st led
Jumped Ok over-raced early 1-1 Joined in with winner Quickly Beaten off # no match at all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Passing the 800m, when racing keenly, was eased to avoid the heels of  a runner which shifted in.
